item.title: Build a Local LLM Agent with pi + LM Studio and Custom Skills
item.author: marcomatto@gmail.com (Marco Martorana)
item.description:
Build a Local LLM Agent with pi + LM Studio

You don’t need a cloud API to have a capable coding agent. In this guide we run pi — the coding agent — entirely offline against a local model served by LM Studio, and then we extend it with four custom skills:
